title: Wave 0: fmt + clippy sweep + enforcement gates
description: Tree has 8,465-line rustfmt drift and 126 clippy warnings (66 auto-fixable). Mechanical cleanup as separate commits, then standing enforcement so drift cannot re-accumulate. Finding: fmt-clippy-hygiene.

acceptance_criteria.text: cargo fmt applied as its own commit; hash added to .git-blame-ignore-revs
cargo clippy --fix sweep applied; remaining warnings triaged or fixed; cargo clippy --all-targets --no-deps exits warning-free or with documented allows
pre-commit hook runs cargo fmt --check and clippy gate (language-aware dispatch, see arc notes)
cargo test still 738/738 green after sweeps

messages.author: user
messages.text: Standing enforcement is now live (2026-06-09, done outside this task): (1) global PostToolUse Edit|Write|MultiEdit hook ~/.claude/hooks/format-on-edit.sh auto-formats .rs/.dart/.py on every agent edit (rustfmt with Cargo.toml edition detection / dart format / ruff when installed); (2) global git pre-commit dispatcher ~/.config/git/hooks/pre-commit (core.hooksPath) format-checks STAGED files per language and chains to repo-local hooks. Both verified live. Remaining scope here: the one-time cargo fmt sweep + .git-blame-ignore-revs, the clippy --fix sweep, and deciding the clippy gate placement (deliberately NOT in pre-commit — clippy compiles, too slow per-commit; consider CI or session-end). NOTE: until the fmt sweep lands, any edit to a sutra file will auto-format the whole file and drag formatting noise into content commits — do this task FIRST.
